forecast_limits: Only one adaptive TRAIN seed and two GEN repeats at this snapshot. The two TRAIN seeds1817/2817 held until frozen-pair confirmation have not both completed; including817 later yields three trained-seed aggregates, not three independent confirmations.
Actual2097048sample exposure is about4.249epochs, not128epochs. LaterLR and adaptiveEMA ceiling regimes differ, so no numerical128epoch forecast is supported.

Lat/angle histograms are onroad-only and conditional on each generated vehicle population; report all-vehicle onroad coverage alongside them. Lower latJSD alone does not prove more road-aligned vehicles.
Low-speed[0,1)m/s is resolvable; exact stationary or sub1m/s thresholds are not. Rare shape/speed tails may improve differently from bulk JSD.
Full50k comparison requires reading its actual histograms and gates. Do not project these4096-scene histogram values onto the full evaluation.

ego_sincos.interpretation: This long arm inherits the joint shape_p2+speed4 recipe. Relative to new_control it changes the joint loss and ego context; it is not a pure angle-context ablation.

combo_batch256_ego_sincos.interpretation: Same joint loss and context as the long ego_sincos arm; the intended difference is batch size256 vs512, with doubled updates at exactly matched sample exposure.

combo_vs_long_ego_batch_policy_audit.comparison_basis: B2568192 vs B5124096, both2097048sample exposure, same TRAIN817 initial generator and map, same TRAIN order and calibration. Batch grouping, optimizer/EMA update counts, and runtime differ; none is an additional loss or angle-representation intervention.
combo_vs_long_ego_batch_policy_audit.remaining_scope: One adaptive training seed. This identifies the observed batch-policy difference for this shared initialization, not a robust universal or mechanistically isolated batch-size effect.

final_interpretation.frozen_pair_correct: All three arms pass gates. Primary R ranks combo_batch256_ego_sincos(.927498), ego_sincos(.978190), new_control(1). The source-controller frozen candidate is correctly combo. No controller or pair was edited by this audit.
final_interpretation.causal_scope: Both long alternatives use the joint L/W p2 and speed weight4 loss. Baseline-to-ego_sincos results cannot be attributed only to context angle representation. Combo-versus-long-ego holds actual model configs and initial hashes fixed and compares batch policy at equal exposure.
final_interpretation.lat_near_centerline: Among onroad vehicles, actual[0,.3)m mass is25.6851% baseline,25.6529% combo,25.7793% ego_sincos, versus54.4266% matched GT. This broad deviation gap remains almost unchanged. >=1m onroad mass is26.2964%/26.2037%/26.1749% versus4.7687% GT. These are conditional on onroad membership; all-vehicle generated onroad coverage is82.9973%/82.8716%/82.5793% versus99.4208% GT. No asymptotic lat floor is established.
final_interpretation.speed: All three final low-speed[0,1)m/s bands are above GT, not deficient:43.4944% baseline,43.8180% combo,44.3525% ego_sincos vs41.8378% GT. Sparse fast-speed tails move toward GT in alternatives, but total speedJSD is+10.9680% combo and+1.0775% ego_sincos versus baseline.
final_interpretation.rare_shapes: Overall shapeJSD improves in combo, but L>=8m and>=12m and W>=3m tails are still below GT and fall further from GT relative to baseline. Long ego_sincos also underrepresents rare large dimensions. Report whole-distribution JSD and actual tail mass separately.
final_interpretation.early_prediction_risk: All four long checkpoints retain the same primary order, but both alternatives lose relative advantage as exposure grows: comboR .7848→.8644→.8949→.9275; long egoR .8585→.9309→.9717→.9782. Component rankings can reverse despite stable overall order; these nested4.249epoch endpoints do not numerically forecast128epoch outcomes.
final_interpretation.confirmation_role: TRAIN817 selected the pair adaptively. TRAIN1817/2817 are the two held-until-freeze confirmations; two generation repeats per TRAIN are not independent training trials.
